  WHY: If gh_helpers.sh fails to source, sanitize_codex_prompt_file is undefined and the reviewer pipeline aborts under set -euo pipefail.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: sanitize_codex_prompt_file function, `iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8//IGNORE` line | confidence=3
